name: openstory
description: Generate entire films, episodes, and micro-dramas from a script (create-sequence), or single images and video clips, mint a library style from refs (create-style), play a cut from clips, stills, and a music bed (stitch), and connect the OpenStory MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Turn a script into an entire film, episode, or micro-drama, with scenes, dialogue, and music. Generate single images and video clips directly from a prompt, reference images, or start and end frames. Mint a library style from refs and share a cut of clips, stills, and a music bed. Installing the plugin also connects the hosted OpenStory MCP server at https://openstory.so/mcp. Sign-in is OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second OpenStory video from this image
Turn this script into an OpenStory micro-drama
Mint an OpenStory style from these references
